entries.name: Nano Banana Image Generation
entries.description: Generate ecommerce images with the Nano Banana base image model. The model is fixed by this API, so provider must not be supplied in the request.

entries.name: Nano Banana Pro Image Generation
entries.description: Generate higher-resolution ecommerce images with the Nano Banana Pro model. The model is fixed by this API, so provider must not be supplied in the request.

entries.name: Nano Banana 2 Image Generation
entries.description: Generate ecommerce images with the Nano Banana 2 model. The model is fixed by this API, so provider must not be supplied in the request.

entries.name: Nano Banana 2.1 Image Generation
entries.description: Generate and edit ecommerce images with Nano Banana 2.1, with improved text layout and consistency across editing rounds. The model is fixed by this API, so provider must not be supplied in the request.

entries.name: Nano Banana 2 Lite Image Generation
entries.description: Generate ecommerce images with the Nano Banana 2 Lite model. The model is fixed by this API, so provider must not be supplied in the request.

entries.name: Wan 2.7 Image Generation
entries.description: Generate ecommerce images with the Wan 2.7 image model. The model is fixed by this API, so provider must not be supplied in the request.

entries.name: Seedream 5 Pro Image Generation
entries.description: Generate ecommerce images with the Seedream 5 Pro image model. The model is fixed by this API, so provider must not be supplied in the request.

entries.name: GPT Image 2 Generation
entries.description: Generate ecommerce images with the GPT Image 2 model and optional quality control. The model is fixed by this API, so provider must not be supplied in the request.

entries.name: GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst
entries.description: Create and edit ecommerce visuals with precise instruction following, broad visual-style support, world-knowledge grounding, and reliable text rendering through the GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst route. The model is fixed by this API, so provider must not be supplied in the request.

entries.name: GPT Image 2.5 Flare
entries.description: Create and edit ecommerce visuals with detailed instruction following, flexible visual styles, world-knowledge grounding, and dependable text rendering through the GPT Image 2.5 Flare route. The model is fixed by this API, so provider must not be supplied in the request.

entries.name: Seedance 2.0 Video Generation
entries.description: Generate a video with Seedance 2.0 using a primary image, up to 9 reference images, or a reference video. The model is fixed by this API, so videoType must not be supplied in the request.

entries.name: Seedance 2.0 Fast Video Generation
entries.description: Generate a faster Seedance 2.0 video using a primary image, up to 9 reference images, or a reference video. The model is fixed by this API, so videoType must not be supplied in the request.

entries.name: Seedance 2.0 Mini Video Generation
entries.description: Generate a compact Seedance 2.0 video using a primary image, up to 9 reference images, or a reference video. The model is fixed by this API, so videoType must not be supplied in the request.

entries.name: Seedance 2.5 Video Generation
entries.description: Generate a Seedance 2.5 video using a primary image, up to 30 reference images, or a reference video. The model is fixed by this API, so videoType must not be supplied in the request.

entries.name: Kling 2.6 Video Generation
entries.description: Generate a Kling 2.6 video using a first frame, first/last frames, or up to 2 reference images. The model is fixed by this API, so videoType must not be supplied in the request.

entries.name: Kling 3 Omni Video Generation
entries.description: Generate a Kling 3 Omni video using first/last frames or up to 7 reference images. The model is fixed by this API, so videoType must not be supplied in the request.

entries.name: Wan 2.6 Video Generation
entries.description: Generate a Wan 2.6 video from a required primary image with optional camera control. The model is fixed by this API, so videoType must not be supplied in the request.

entries.name: Hailuo 2.3 Video Generation
entries.description: Generate a Hailuo 2.3 video from a required primary image; the aspect ratio is adaptive. The model is fixed by this API, so videoType must not be supplied in the request.

entries.name: Happy Horse 2 Video Generation
entries.description: Generate a Happy Horse 2 video from 1 to 9 required reference images. The model is fixed by this API, so videoType must not be supplied in the request.

entries.name: Wan 3 Video Generation
entries.description: Generate a Wan 3 video from up to 10 image references, first and final frames, or a reference video. The model is fixed by this API, so videoType must not be supplied in the request.

entries.name: MiniMax H3 Video Generation
entries.description: Generate a MiniMax H3 video from 1 to 9 required reference images. The model is fixed by this API, so videoType must not be supplied in the request.

entries.name: MiniMax H3 Lite Video Generation
entries.description: Generate a MiniMax H3 Lite video from 1 to 9 required reference images. The model is fixed by this API, so videoType must not be supplied in the request.

entries.name: AI Model Swap API
entries.description: Generate model images by combining a source product image with a model head image, optional masks, scene references, and prompt guidance.

entries.name: AI Model Swap API 2.0
entries.description: Generate model images from a product image and a full model reference image with optional segmentation and scene controls.

entries.name: AI Model Scene & Background Replacement API
entries.description: Generate scene variants for a model image using either a scene reference image or a text scene prompt.

entries.name: AI Clothes Changer API for Tops & Bottoms
entries.description: Dress a model image with upper and/or lower garment assets, supporting optional masks and original garment references.

entries.name: AI Suit Virtual Try-On API
entries.description: Dress a model image with a one-piece outfit or suit image, supporting optional garment and model masks.

entries.name: Virtual Try-On API
entries.description: Generate wearable-product imagery from a source person image and target product image.

entries.name: Product Replacement API
entries.description: Use source and target product references to replace product content while preserving scene consistency.

entries.name: Product Scene Variations API
entries.description: Generate multiple ecommerce scene variants from a product image, optional segmentation, and prompt guidance.

entries.name: AI Background Generator API
entries.description: Create product or lifestyle scene images from text prompts and optional reference images.

entries.name: Similar Image Variations API
entries.description: Generate similar ecommerce images from a reference image with optional prompt and strength controls.

entries.name: Background Remover API
entries.description: Cut out products, people, or clothing from a source image using an upstream background-removal model.

entries.name: Fine Cutout Image Segmentation API
entries.description: Run the Nexscope interactive cutout create/info flow as one Skill API call. The point list marks foreground/background guidance points.

entries.name: Image Upscale API
entries.description: Increase image resolution and optionally enhance visual quality.

entries.name: Smart Image Outpainting API
entries.description: Generate an expanded image around the original content using target width, height, and optional prompt.

entries.name: Image Translation API
entries.description: Translate image text from a source language to a target language for ecommerce localization.

entries.name: AI Hand Repair API
entries.description: Improve hand appearance in generated model or lifestyle images.

entries.name: Image Inpainting API
entries.description: Repair or regenerate a local image region using a mask and prompt.

entries.name: Print & Pattern Extraction API
entries.description: Extract visible print or pattern elements from product imagery.

entries.name: Object Eraser & Image Object Removal API
entries.description: Remove selected objects or regions using a mask image.

entries.name: Jewelry Text Design API
entries.description: Create decorative linked-word imagery using font, size, and prompt controls.

entries.name: Handheld Product Mockup API
entries.description: Generate natural hand-held product imagery from a person image and target product asset.

entries.name: Image Captioning API
entries.description: Extract descriptive prompts or selling-point text from one or more images.

entries.name: Product Image Enhancement API
entries.description: Improve product presentation quality in a single ecommerce image.

entries.name: Image Text Editing API
entries.description: Use an image mask to remove or edit text regions in an ecommerce image.

entries.name: Smart Image Edit & Manipulation API v3
entries.description: Perform general image editing with provider, prompt, resolution, aspect ratio, and quality controls.

entries.name: Smart Multi-Image Editing API v3
entries.description: Create an edited output from multiple source images using prompt, provider, resolution, and quality controls.

entries.name: White Background Product Image API
entries.description: Generate one square white-background product image from one or two references of the same product using GPT Image 2. Submit one approved target per request. Review product identity and listing suitability before use; this endpoint does not perform reference inspection, image-set planning, or marketplace compliance certification. Generation consumes Nexscope credits.

entries.name: AI Video Reclone API
entries.description: Generate a product marketing video using a reference video, reference images, and model-specific generation settings.

entries.name: AI Product Marketing Image Set API v4
entries.description: Create ecommerce product marketing materials such as selling-point images and A+ style visuals from product images and brief inputs.

entries.name: AI Apparel Image Set & Photography API v3
entries.description: Create apparel ecommerce image sets from clothing images with optional model and scene references.

entries.name: AI Model Pose Generation API
entries.description: Generate model pose variations from an input image and either a pose prompt or posture reference image.

entries.name: Sales Talking Video API
entries.description: Create a product-selling video from prompt and product image references.

entries.name: Product Logo Detection & Removal API
entries.description: Detect and optionally remove a specified brand logo from a product image.

entries.name: One-Click Image Recoloring API v2
entries.description: Recolor the requested subject using one or more target colors.
